summary: Phase 1.2 (Ask the Bureau chat) and Phase 1.3 (Feedback loop) tested end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/projects/{id}/ask returns {msg_id, question, answer, cited_reports, created_at} with answer grounded in last 2 complete reports (cited_reports=[rpt_synth0000001, rpt_0bed032da95d]); GET /api/projects/{id}/chat returns chronological list; DELETE clears it; 401 without auth, 400 on empty question, 404 on non-existent project. Feedback CRUD upserts via POST /api/reports/{id}/feedback (tried/worked), GET returns map keyed by item_key, status=null deletes the item, 401 without auth. Frontend: chat-panel renders on ProjectDetail; all 4 suggested prompts render when history empty; chat-input + chat-send fire request, show optimistic 'thinking…' placeholder, then real answer (~500 char) and cited reports surface; clear-chat resets to suggested prompts. Report page: all 3 feedback-idea_0-{tried,worked,didnt_work} render; seeded 'tried' state restored visually after reload; clicking feedback-idea_2-worked persists to backend and survives full page reload. Public share view (/share/{token}) renders zero feedback-idea_* buttons (disabled prop respected).
